description: An ascending fragment from Serein Switchyard moves into the bass as G–A–B-flat–D. Above it, a slower melody and an independent inner line open different lengths of phrase. The G-minor centre travels through B-flat, B and E major before a C-major reflection leads towards E minor. A semitone descent into E-flat minor turns the music back towards G, with a quiet added sixth in the close.

Five-beat bars, separate phrase lengths and chromatic shifts between distant tonal areas require independent voicing. The score uses two pages to give the three lines space.

performance.note: The upper line remains distinct from the softer inner motion; the bass opening has a little extra presence. Broader five-bar upper phrasing crosses the shorter lower phrases. The two final semitone shifts are allowed to settle before the last minor-sixth sonority.

title: Opal Stairwell

performance.note: The sustained bass is not reattacked at the bar lines. Its held key preserves the centre while the pedal clears each upper sonority. The whole-tone ascent broadens towards its peak, then releases into G; the final change from minor to major remains very soft.

title: Sorrel Pendulum
description: Opal Stairwell’s whole-tone fragment becomes A-flat–B-flat–C–D, now heard as a Lydian opening. A-flat and D-flat colours give way to E and B major before a semitone return opens the route to an A-flat sixth/ninth close.

performance.note: The cross-rhythms remain soft and even within each hand, arriving without an accent on the shared final beat. Harmonic shifts carry the phrase forward. The last three bars gradually withdraw into a low, warm sixth/ninth voicing.

title: Silver Culvert

performance.note: The melodic handovers keep a similar dynamic weight, with the bass lifted slightly when it takes over a phrase. Pedal clears around the exposed exchanges. The two hands gradually overlap more fully before the final compact major-ninth chord.

title: Quartz Overpass

title: Sable Orchard

title: Thistle Horizon
